name: IIC President
uses: Yes, ultimately. Owns the portal login and is custodian of uploaded data, so is the account of record even where day-to-day entry is delegated to the Convener.
decides: Likely the internal decision-maker for adopting a tool, because they can change council membership and monitor deliverables. But no source establishes that the President decides anything about procurement.
pays: UNKNOWN. No source states the President holds or controls a budget line.
approves: UNKNOWN for the purchase itself. At IIT Palakkad the administrative approval of a purchase is Registrar/Dean(ICSR), not the IIC President.
official_responsibility: Holds the IIC portal Login ID and is "custodian of IIC portal login and data/ reports uploaded therein". Constitutes the council, chairs quarterly council meetings, is the main point of contact with the MHRD Innovation Cell, and is "responsible for submitting the monthly progress/activity reports on the IIC portal".
notes: The strongest asset in Class A: a named officeholder who is formally the custodian of the data a replacement product would own. But custodian-of-data is not budget authority.

name: IIC Vice President
uses: No operational role described in any source read.
decides: Not described as a decision-maker in any source read.
official_responsibility: "An Honorary post for a senior expert representative from Industry/Ecosystem enablers." At IIT Hyderabad the office is held by the Dean (R&D).
notes: Listed by the portal as an assignable role but described as HONORARY. Likely a credibility seat for external industry members. Worth interviewing as a champion, not as a buyer.

name: IIC Convener
uses: Yes - the primary operator. Day-to-day activity, data collection from members, coordination across departments, and compilation of the annual report in practice.
decides: Yes, within the council. Cannot change council membership (President can) but controls what is presented, and effectively sets the quarterly agenda.
pays: UNKNOWN, and this is the single most important unknown in Phase 2. Every source read describes authority to SPEND money; none describes a budget line to spend FROM. The Convener is frequently a part-time academic - Phase 1 found SSCET fielding 40 IIC members, 30 innovation ambassadors and 2 mentors (P1 corpus IIC-024).
approves: Not the purchase approver. But at IIT Palakkad, purchases above Rs 25 lakh go to an Exclusive Purchase Committee whose composition explicitly includes the "Indenter (Convenor)" - so at high spend the Convener gets a formal vote.
official_responsibility: "This is more responsible role, the person who is assigned to this role should carry out the day to day activity under IIC." Describes self as "Immediate point of contact and coordination" and "Preferably Incubation in charge of institute or Faculty with Entrepreneurship Experience or interest." Collects inputs from all council members at regular intervals. The portal instructs that no extra roles be assigned to Convener.
notes: The most probable champion and the most probable first user. The user-decides-pays split for this role is the central open question of Phase 2. Portal guidance forbids stacking extra roles onto Convener, which concentrates the operational load.

name: YUKTI Coordinator
uses: Yes, narrowly. Collects and verifies YUKTI submissions. This is the one office whose described job is already a data-collection task.
decides: Verifies submissions - a gatekeeping act, but over YUKTI entries only.
official_responsibility: "This person will be responsible for the collection of ideas/prototype/startup information from their institute students/alumni/faculty/incubates and to verify the submission." May hold an additional role.
notes: The cleanest possible overlap between an existing mandated office and a product surface. YUKTI-NIR is already in the Phase 0 differentiation thesis; this role is who would actually use it.

name: Social Media Coordinator
uses: Publication only. No overlap with innovation records.
decides: No.
official_responsibility: Manages the IIC page/account and publishes council resolutions, action plans and activity posts.
notes: A portal-enforced office with no StartupHub-relevant workload. Worth recording because it proves the portal mandates seats by category rather than by workload - which is exactly why Class A seats are not a proxy for user demand.

name: Innovation Activity Coordinator
uses: Yes. And in the Phase 1 corpus this is the office that literally compiles the annual report - named explicitly at Scottish Church College.
decides: Implements council decisions.
official_responsibility: Responsible for all innovation-related activities; brings ideas to the council and implements activities.
notes: Directly evidenced as the report compiler at one institution. This is the office that does the hand-assembly work described in Phase 1 problem P-A08.

name: Internship Activity Coordinator
uses: Internship placement only.
decides: No.
official_responsibility: Arranges student internships in startups and promotes internship-related activities.
notes: Frequently student-held - at IIT Hyderabad the seat is a BTech 4th year student. Recorded here as churn evidence, not as a buyer.

name: IPR Activity Coordinator
uses: Yes, and this role owns the CRITICAL problem found in Phase 1 (P-A07): no institution in the 36-document corpus shows a patent deadline field anywhere.
decides: Brings IPR matters to the council.
pays: UNKNOWN. Note KAPILA (MoE KAPILA) funds patent filings and is a plausible source, but no source read establishes that.
official_responsibility: Promotes IPR awareness and conducts IPR-related activities on campus.
notes: The strongest CHAMPION candidate and the weakest decision-maker. Owns the highest-severity documented problem but sits below the Convener in authority and has no procurement role. Also frequently student-held (MTech 3rd year at IIT Hyderabad), which makes the seat itself unstable.

name: Startup Activity Coordinator
uses: Yes. At IIT Hyderabad the seat is held by the Faculty-in-Charge of the Incubation Centre, making it the overlap with Class B's Incubation Manager.
decides: Implements council decisions on startup matters.
official_responsibility: Responsible for all startup-related activities and for boosting startup generation among students.
notes: The natural seat for the venture-register product implied by Phase 1 problems P-A01 and P-A06.

name: ARIIA Coordinator
uses: Yes, and most acutely. ARIIA demands patent application numbers, year and commercialisation figures. Phase 0 established (D-004) that institutions therefore maintain a SEPARATE off-platform patent ledger purely to answer this screen.
decides: Advises the council on rank improvement.
official_responsibility: "Primary responsible for creating repository and advising on more innovation and startup activities in campus to increase the ranking in ARIIA." Marked optional in the institutional charters but present in the MIC portal role list.
notes: Owns the repository. This is the role whose job description is literally "creating a repository" - i.e. the role that already does by hand what a system of record would do. Deep-dived in Decision_Map.

name: NIRF Coordinator
uses: Yes, and the evidence here is strong and independent of Phase 1: NIRF's Data Capture System forms are published in full by institutions - NIT Rourkela, IIM Goa, JBIET and Rajah Serfoji Government College were all verified as posting their own submitted forms on the open web in Phase 0.
decides: Advises the council on rank improvement.
official_responsibility: "Primary responsible for creating repository and advising on more innovation and Research activities in campus to increase the ranking in NIRF." Also marked optional in institutional charters but present in the MIC portal role list.
notes: Deep-dived jointly with A-10, because the two roles are routinely held by the same person and drive the same two screens.

name: IIC Member
uses: Presence at events and discussions is the stated requirement.
decides: No seat described.
official_responsibility: No additional responsibilities. Portal states at least one is required and "there is no less / more important role under this category, all the persons share equal".
notes: Required to exist but undefined in scope. Relevant as the pool StartupHub would licence for read access, and as evidence that IIC membership is much larger than the number of people who do the work - Phase 1 found 40 members, 30 ambassadors and 2 mentors at SSCET.

name: Vice Chancellor / Director
uses: Not a direct user. But holds or heads the IIC presidency at several institutions, so is structurally the IIC's institutional owner.
decides: Yes, at the top. CRSU vests administrative and financial approval above Rs 2,00,000 in the Vice-Chancellor; NIT Warangal gives the Director 'All Cases'.
pays: YES - and this is one of only two roles in Phase 2 where budget authority is DOCUMENTED. NIT Warangal: Director = all cases. CRSU: VC = without limit. NITK: Director is the final approver in the administrative approval chain.
approves: Yes, at the ceiling of the authority chain.
official_responsibility: Head of institution. At IIT Hyderabad the IIC President is the Director; at SurTech the IIC President is the Principal.
notes: Budget authority DOCUMENTED here because three independent procurement manuals grant it explicitly. That is what makes this grade different from every Class A seat.

name: Dean / Innovation Head
uses: Not a daily user of innovation records.
decides: Yes. At ICAR-WII the SPC-II - which handles all purchases above Rs 2.00 lacs - is chaired by the DEAN.
pays: YES - DOCUMENTED. NIT Warangal: Deputy Director / Registrar / Dean (R&D) Rs 10,00,000 non-consumable, Rs 5,00,000 consumable. ICAR-WII: Dean chairs the committee covering all purchases above Rs 2.00 lacs.
approves: Yes. NITK's administrative approval chain passes through Dean (P&D) for cost above Rs 3 Lakhs. IIT Palakkad requires 'Administrative Approval of the Registrar / Dean (ICSR)' as part of the audit pack.
official_responsibility: Dean (R&D) / Dean (ICSR) / Coordinator (R&D) across institutions. At IIT Hyderabad the IIC Vice President is the Dean (R&D).
notes: The most likely approver inside StartupHub's price band, because the Rs 2.5-10 lakh tier sits with a Dean/Registrar at every institution measured.

name: Incubation Manager / TBI Manager
uses: Yes for venture-level data - but Phase 1 P-A03 found NO cohort concept anywhere in the 36-document corpus, so what they record is not established.
decides: No procurement role found in any source read.
pays: UNKNOWN. A DST/AIC TBI grant would be the plausible route, but no source read confirms it.
official_responsibility: "Preferably Incubation in charge of institute" is the portal's own guidance for who should be Convener. At IIT Hyderabad the Startup Activity Coordinator is the Faculty-in-Charge of the Incubation Centre.
notes: Frequently the SAME PERSON as the IIC Convener, per the MIC portal's own guidance. Do not model as two distinct seats without Phase 3 confirmation.

name: Entrepreneurship Cell / E-Cell
uses: Student-facing engagement; runs competitions and exhibitions.
decides: No.
pays: No budget of its own in any source read.
official_responsibility: A student body. At IIT Hyderabad the student-held Startup Activity Coordinator is 'Head, E Cell'.
notes: High churn by construction - student body. Valuable as a distribution channel, not as a buyer, and not as a seat to licence.

name: Faculty Coordinator / Head of Department
uses: Yes - this is where innovation data ORIGINATES. Phase 1 P-A10 found Teresa's College's grant field organised entirely by department, which is this person filling in a form.
decides: Recommends specifications and quantities.
pays: Single-SOURCE. NITK: HoD signs for cost above Rs 1 Lakh. NIT Warangal: HoD has Rs 2,50,000 non-consumable and Rs 1,00,000 consumable authority - so at the bottom of StartupHub's band a HoD may be able to approve alone.
approves: Yes at low value. NIT Warangal grants the HoD Rs 2,50,000 non-consumable authority; software is classed non-consumable in most of these manuals.
official_responsibility: Raises the indent (requisition) for a departmental purchase. Under NITK rules the 'Faculty-in-charge of Purchase (buyer)' initiates the process.
notes: The only role in the entire map that may be able to approve StartupHub at the entry price point WITHOUT a committee - and only if that price stays under about Rs 1 lakh. This is the single strongest argument for a low entry tier.

name: Startup Manager
uses: Yes. Phase 1 P-A01/P-A06 found institutions cannot produce a defensible venture list and report startups as a stock, not a movement.
decides: No procurement role found.
official_responsibility: Not a distinct office in any IIC charter read; functionally the Startup Activity Coordinator (A-09).
notes: todo.md lists this as a separate role from the IIC President/Coordinator, but no source read separates it. Flagged as a probable duplicate of A-09 pending Phase 3.

name: Registrar / Dean (ICSR)
uses: No. Appears in this map only as an approver. Phase 0 already recorded the sharpest version of this: a competitor's analysis concludes "Their buyer is the Principal/Registrar. The IIC nodal officer - StartupHub's actual buyer - has no seat in that buying decision."
decides: Yes. CRSU vests administrative and financial approval above Rs 2,00,000 in the VC AFTER the Registrar's own ceiling of Rs 2,00,000 - making the Registrar the decision point for the middle band.
pays: YES - DOCUMENTED. NIT Warangal: Registrar Rs 10,00,000 non-consumable, Rs 5,00,000 consumable. CRSU: Registrar up to Rs 2,00,000. UoH: Registrar Rs 1,50,000 without pre-check, Rs 5,00,000 with Purchase Committee recommendation.
approves: Yes. This is the role that signs. In every institution measured, the IIC Convener recommends and the Registrar or Dean administratively approves.
official_responsibility: Grants administrative approval for purchases and holds delegated financial limits. At IIT Palakkad the 'Administrative Approval of the Registrar / Dean (ICSR) for the Purchase' is a required document in the audit pack above Rs 10 lakh.
notes: Added per D-019. Deep-dived because it is the most probable approver of a StartupHub-scale purchase. The uncomfortable finding: the person who will sign has no reason to care about innovation records and every reason to care about procurement risk and precedent.

name: Purchase Committee
uses: No.
decides: Yes. Scrutinises requirement, budget position, comparative statements and vendor selection, then recommends.
pays: Single-SOURCE. Committees do not hold budget; they recommend against a budget. At Sathyabama the Central Purchase Committee is headed by the VC.
approves: Yes, recommendentially. Its recommendation must then be ratified by a competent financial authority - which is why it is not the final approver.
official_responsibility: Constituted differently almost everywhere, but always includes the indenter, a finance member and faculty. IIT Palakkad EPC: Chairperson, Indenter (Convener), 2-3 faculty, Purchase Nominee, Finance Nominee. MITE: Chairperson is the Trust Chairman, Convener is the Principal, members are Vice Principal and HoDs.
notes: The gate. Triggered at a remarkably consistent threshold across both segments: about Rs 1 lakh. Below it, a HoD may act; above it, a committee is engaged.

name: Finance Nominee / Finance Officer
uses: No.
decides: Yes, and unusually powerful. At ICAR-WII, SPC-I and SPC-II quorum REQUIRES the presence of the Chairman, the Finance Officer or the Internal Audit Officer. A finance officer can therefore block a purchase alone.
pays: YES - DOCUMENTED. CRSU grants the Finance Officer administrative and financial approval up to Rs 15,000; UoH up to Rs 25,000. Small, real, and documented.
approves: Recommends and can block; does not hold the final signature at larger values.
official_responsibility: Sits on every purchase committee. Sathyabama's Central Purchase Committee is headed by the VC with the Registrar, Finance Officer, 2-3 management members, a Dean and a HoD. WII's SPC-I and SPC-II both require the Finance Officer and Internal Audit Officer to be present, and quorum is broken without them.
notes: The most underrated role in the map. Often the only person who asks the question that actually matters: what happens to this spend next year?

name: Audit / Internal Audit Officer
uses: No.
decides: Reviews documentation completeness and ratification of expenditure.
approves: YES for purchases above about Rs 10 lakh - and at IIT Palakkad the purchase order is not issued until audit approval is received.
official_responsibility: Required in the purchase chain above defined thresholds. IIT Palakkad: purchases above Rs 10 lakh are presented to the Audit for perusal and approval, and the PO/WO is issued only on receipt of audit approval. WII: checklist to the competent authority above Rs 10.00 lakhs; IAO is a mandatory SPC member.
notes: Below StartupHub's entire realistic band at most institutions, but decisive at the top of the Incubatee price point (~Rs 3.95 lakh is under it; a university-wide deal is not). Relevant if StartupHub ever sells campus-wide.

name: IT Administrator
uses: Would administer hosting, SSO and access.
decides: Likely, on technical fit. Phase 0 established data localisation and on-premise requirements as a near-universal procurement condition, and found EcoSync already disqualified on exactly this axis by answering 'no' to SOC 2 and ISO 27001.
approves: Advisory in the sources read; no source names them as an approver.
official_responsibility: Not a named role in any procurement manual read. Present implicitly via data-residency and security requirements.
notes: Role listed in todo.md but evidenced only indirectly. The honest position: this role is a plausible technical gate, not a documented one. Phase 24 must test it.

name: Student Innovators
uses: Yes, at the intake end - they are the source of ideas, prototypes and applications. Phase 1 found NIT Calicut running Demo Days with 57 UG/PG student projects and 155 ideas generated in one year.
decides: No institutional decision authority.
official_responsibility: Student representation on the IIC is mandatory - up to 10 student coordinators per category are permitted alongside faculty.
notes: Also frequently HOLD Class A seats (Internship Coordinator, IPR Coordinator at IIT Hyderabad were undergraduates). So a single human can be both the mandated officeholder and an end user.

name: Founders / Startups
uses: Presumed, not evidenced. Phase 1 P-A01 found 38 of NIT Calicut's 55 reported startups fell into an unattributed 'others' category - so StartupHub cannot currently establish who its own ventures are.
decides: No.
official_responsibility: Not an institutional office. Incubatees of the institution.
notes: Deliberately left mostly unevidenced. No source read describes founders as system users, and Phase 1 shows institutions cannot even identify them. Phase 3 must test whether founders are users of the institution's system at all.
